compilation.basis: Calibrated from overall plan dimensions: horizontal 15000mm span pixel x=430 to x=1812; vertical 8000mm span pixel y=1082(bottom outer wall,world y=0) to y=342(top outer wall,world y=8). Outer footprint uses observed outer gray wall faces. Interior: one full-height spine wall at px x=1120 dividing two top meeting rooms; three spine walls at px x=733,1077,1427 dividing four bottom offices; both spine sets stop at a full-width corridor band py=604 to py=804 (open, no partition crossing it), matching the same layout pattern observed on 1f_view.png. Door apertures measured from swing-arc symbols flanking the spine walls at the corridor faces.
